Name: Duruznik's Portraits for Juliet and Jessie
Author: Duruznik
Description:
Using my other portrait mods for your game, but want Juliet and Jessie to match too? Here, try these on for size. Covers all outfits, events, the works!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52394/52394-1789570029-688251244.png[/img]

1. You will need to have [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI[/b] [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]Content Patcher[/b] [/url]installed. 
2. This is a hi-res mod, which means you'll need to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36813][b]Scale Up Unofficial[/b][/url] installed.
3. Simply download the file and drop it into your mods folder. 

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52394/52394-1789570258-1447226643.png[/img]

Find my other portrait mods here!

[b]                        [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46344]Duruznik's Vanilla Portraits[/url]                                         [color=#e69138][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52562]Duruznik's Portraits for Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46344][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52562/52562-1789797642-1418497359.png[/img][/url]    [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52562][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55992/55992-1795548020-1123075003.png[/img][/url][/b]

More mod support coming soon!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52394/52394-1789609371-551493326.png[/img]

For best experience, use alongside my vanilla portraits. Specifically, version 2.0 and up. The older versions might cause some weird conflicts.

Incompatible with other portraits that edit Juliet & Jessie. Mods that edit a bunch of characters that include Juliet & Jessie should work for the other characters, but you might get weird glitches with Juliet & Jessie specifically.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52562/52562-1789758777-1548795477.png[/img]

Also a massive shoutout to the good folks in the Stardew Valley Discord server's modding community!
